Dhurandhar: The Revenge is the upcoming 2026 Indian Hindi-language spy action thriller that serves as the explosive finale to Aditya Dhar's high-octane duology.

Key Movie Details

Director: Aditya Dhar (of Uri: The Surgical Strike fame).

Lead Cast: Ranveer Singh as Hamza Ali Mazari / Jaskirat Singh Rangi, Sanjay Dutt, R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sara Arjun, and Rakesh Bedi.

Release Date: March 19, 2026 (coinciding with Gudi Padwa, Ugadi, and Eid al-Fitr).

Run Time: Approximately 235 minutes (nearly 4 hours), making it one of the longest Indian films ever made.

Soundtrack: Composed by Shashwat Sachdev with lyrics by Irshad Kamil; the first single "Aari Aari" was released on March 12, 2026.

Plot Summary

The film picks up immediately after the massive cliffhanger of the first part. The story follows Jaskirat Singh Rangi, an undercover Indian intelligence agent who has infiltrated the deepest levels of Karachi's criminal underworld under the alias Hamza Ali Mazari.

As he balances his life as a spy and his rise within the syndicates, the sequel delves into his origin story while he executes a high-stakes mission to dismantle political power structures in Pakistan and avenge the 26/11 attacks. The stakes are higher than ever as his true identity teeters on the edge of exposure.

Major Buzz & Accolades

Cinematic Scale: Shot back-to-back with Part 1 across Thailand, Punjab, and Mumbai, featuring massive action set-pieces re-creating Karachi's Lyari area.

Box Office Hype: The film has already minted over ₹60 crore in global advance bookings even before domestic pre-sales fully opened in India.

Cinematic Universe: Rumors are swirling about a massive cameo by Yami Gautam, potentially linking the film to the Uri universe.

Streaming & Media

OTT Platform: After its theatrical run, the film is set to stream on JioHotstar (estimated around May 2026).

Re-Release: To build hype, the original Dhurandhar (2025) was re-released in over 500 theaters worldwide on March 12, 2026.

📺 Platform: Prime Video
🎭 Genre: Drama, Mystery

Plot Overview:
Sterling Point follows 17-year-old Annie Jacobson, a smart and ambitious girl living in New York with her twin brother Connor and their father. After Annie’s estranged grandfather dies, she discovers that he has left Annie and Connor a mysterious property on a beautiful Canadian island called Sterling Point.

Annie travels to the island hoping to understand why her grandfather left them this inheritance and to uncover the truth about her late mother and her family’s past. But once she arrives, she discovers that there are far more secrets than she expected—including a girl named Ramona, who turns out to be connected to Annie’s family in a way that changes everything.

While spending the summer there, Annie becomes part of a new group of friends and gets caught in a complicated love triangle between Ellis and Rory. At the same time, she and Connor slowly uncover painful family secrets involving their parents, their grandfather, and Ramona’s identity.

Basically, it’s a mix of summer romance + mystery + family secrets + friendship + coming-of-age. But the main emotional story is actually about Annie and Ramona discovering what family really means and trying to understand the secrets that shaped their lives.

После того как Кунал переезжает в Мумбаи, чтобы поступить в военно-морскую академию, его мир рушится, когда он узнает, что Тара изменила ему.
